source_registry_proposal.title: Radiocarbon Dating of Teotihuacán Mapping Project TE28 Material from Cave under Pyramid of the Sun, Teotihuacán, México
source_registry_proposal.author: Rebecca Sload

findings.subject: Area B:West posthole, radiocarbon sample positions and overlapping age ranges
findings.assertion: Sload 2007 Figure 10 places Beta 220747 partly in the BYCT layer toward the southeast of Area B:West, whereas Beta 220749 and Beta 220750 cluster in the posthole. Beta 220750 is below Beta 220749. Table 2 gives calibrated 2-sigma intervals of 20–220 CE for 220747, 110–330 CE for 220749 and 60–240 CE for 220750. The dates overlap and their calibration intercepts do not establish separate exact post-use dates.
findings.locator: Sload 2007 FAMSI original PDF, printed pp.14–15 Tables 1–2, p.21 Area B text, p.22 Figures 10–11 (original figure screenshots inspected), p.23 interpretation
findings.confidence: source-context documented; post use and timing interpretive
findings.corroboration: Not independently corroborated; 2020 Sload draws on earlier research
findings.geography: Teotihuacan Sun Pyramid cave, Area B:West, Mexico
findings.limitations: Charcoal sample ages do not directly date post installation; original Altschul 1978 notes unavailable; 2007 calibration must be labeled.

findings.subject: SF31 burnt shell concentration near Blockage 12
findings.assertion: Sload 2020 describes SF31 in Area C:West as a circular concentration of burnt iridescent shell approximately 20 cm in diameter and 2 cm thick, with charcoal but no ash, in Layer 4d at the upper surface of BYCT Layer 4e and below Layer 3. She reports alignment with the east edge of Blockage 12 and west edge of Rock 2, but ritual significance is a hypothesis.
findings.locator: Sload 2020 printed p.112, Chapter 7, section 'A Proposed Sequence of Termination Ritual', citing Altschul 1978a:129,131 and 1978b:26; original text examined but figure screenshot timed out
findings.confidence: reported context and measurements; ritual interpretation unverified
findings.geography: Sun Pyramid cave Area C:West near Blockage 12, Mexico
findings.period: Early Teotihuacan period; absolute date unsettled
findings.limitations: 1978 field notes and artifact not independently examined; not the separate 25 × 35 cm burnt shell-and-fishbone fire feature.
